name: Tracey Moroney
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work collaboratively with clients to unpack and process that which is standing in the way of them living a meaningful and fulfilled life. My compassionate, warm, and empathic approach helps to foster this, while remaining trauma informed. I work with adults who are dealing with anxiety, depression, trauma, grief and loss, as well as chronic illness.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing

name: Jackie Ha
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I aim to create a warm and supportive space for people to inquire about how and why their symptoms present in the way that they do. I work collaboratively with people to increase insight, make the unconscious conscious, and help them learn to be with their pain in a way that is present. We do this by exploring their defence mechanisms, internal conflicts, their relationship patterns, and how their early life experiences have informed the way they relate to themselves, others and the world around them.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Babette Sabella
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a psychotherapist with more than 25 years expertise working in a range of modalities. I have specialised in trauma focussed work for for more than 15 years. Areas of expertise include the effects of early childhood trauma, PTSD and refugee trauma. I enjoy the efficacy of EMDR therapy and have been accredited to level 2. Additionally, I am also registered in a 3 - 4 session hypnotherapy modality effective in treating trauma, depression and anxiety.

name: Tanya Short
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Tanya is a registered dramatherapist with over 13 years experience working with children, adolescents and adults. Tanya has experience working with mental health, trauma, learning disability and neurodiversity.

name: Jessica Leskowski
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: I am a facilitator of self empowered healing, helping clients ready to go deeper in their personal journeys learn more about their subconscious, their dreams, their body symptoms and nervous system. My approach is trauma informed with an emphasis on restoring safety in the body before working on traumatic events, and working with the natural healing processes of the nervous system.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic Experiencing, Somatic psychotherapy
